## Objective
Implement a protected, one-shot chronological OOS workflow and complete local search-family accounting for v8-next.

## Owning authority
- D-150 holdout burn and evidence succession principles.
- D-153 Benchmark Fabric and D-156 evaluator boundary.
- docs/issues/ISSUE_KZ004_PURGED_WFA_AND_ONESHOT_FROZEN_OOS_GATE.md
- docs/issues/ISSUE_AUD004B_SEARCH_LINEAGE_AND_MULTIPLICITY_LEDGER.md
- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/forward_plan.py and family.py

## Change class
CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## Current state
v8-next records local development trials and can freeze a future plan, but the economic benchmark uses a descriptive historical split. Complete external search history is not proven, protected OOS burn is not wired into the benchmark evaluator, and failed or omitted attempts cannot yet form a certified complete family.

## Required end state
R1 — Freeze an immutable OOS plan before its window starts.
R2 — Burn the dataset/family lineage atomically on first evaluation, including failed attempts.
R3 — Reject any second access, relabeling, tuning, or reuse of revealed OOS.
R4 — Compare every locally registered family member with explicit roles and hashes.
R5 — Keep all outputs NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM until a separate authority receipt exists.

## Expected file / module surface
- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/forward_plan.py
- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/family.py
- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/store.py
- v8-next/src/v8_next/app/forward.py
- v8-next/tests/test_forward_plan.py
- v8-next/tests/test_family.py

## Verification gates
Test pre-window registration, atomic burn, failed-after-burn recovery, duplicate/relabel rejection, missing-family rejection, and deterministic two-process replay. Run the scoped v8-next suite and real-data-only audit.

## Required evidence artifacts
Immutable plan and burn records; family manifest with every attempted trial; source/code/config hashes; rejection receipts; reproducible OOS report.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
No strategy tuning, no reopening a holdout, no synthetic economic data, no automatic promotion, and no claim of complete hidden search history from local registry coverage.

### Context-completeness contract

### 11. Normative Traceability
R1 — OOS must be frozen before observation. Authority: D-150 and D-153.
R2 — Every attempted member is retained; missing/failed members block comparison. Authority: AUD-004B and family.py.
R3 — Revealed OOS cannot regain untouched status. Authority: KZ-004.

### 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
Reuse ForwardPlan, ResearchStore, trial lineage hashes, DataRole/HOLDOUT, existing NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM statuses, and current idempotent transaction boundaries.

### 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
I1: burn(lineage,dataset) is monotone and cannot return to untouched.
I2: registered family IDs equal computed result IDs exactly.
I3: any missing/failed member blocks rather than disappears.
I4: decision time is after outcome availability.

### 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
Missing/duplicate family -> DATA_BLOCKED or BLOCKED.
Second holdout access -> ALREADY_BURNED/BLOCKED.
Underpowered result -> INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERPOWERED.
Any uncertified result -> NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM.

### 15. Dependency Map
Plan -> immutable registry -> source binding -> all family trials -> evaluator -> receipt/report.

### 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
- If an owning contract or estimand is ambiguous, STOP and open an OPEN_PIN.
- If an artifact cannot be physically produced and hashed, STOP; do not substitute it.
- If the requested behavior would open protected OOS or mint authority, STOP pending explicit governance.

### References / sources / attachments
Related: #257, #300, #322. Current v8-next scope: docs/contracts/V8_NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_SCOPE.md and V8_NEXT_FIRST_SLICE_ACCEPTANCE.md.

### V8 guards
- [x] I will not invent a new canonical error code, ontology, or parallel interface unless an R# requirement explicitly authorizes it.
- [x] No unrelated semantic strategy change is bundled into this implementation issue.
- [x] No frozen OOS is opened unless this issue explicitly carries that authority.
- [x] If the owning contract is ambiguous, I will open/escalate an OPEN_PIN rather than invent an interpretation.
